docs.text: To roll back a failed deployment, scale the old replicaset up and the new one down, then verify health checks.
Horizontal pod autoscaling adds replicas when CPU exceeds the target; configure min and max replica counts.
The authentication API issues a bearer token from the login endpoint; include it in the Authorization header.
The public API enforces a rate limit of one hundred requests per minute per API key; exceeding it returns 429.
Nightly database backups are written to object storage and retained for thirty days before expiry.
To restore from backup, download the latest snapshot from object storage and replay it into a fresh database.
Configure TLS by mounting the certificate and private key, then set the minimum protocol version to 1.2.
Set the log level with an environment variable; structured JSON logs are shipped to the aggregation pipeline.
New engineers request repository access, install the toolchain, and run the local stack before their first change.
During an incident, the on-call engineer declares severity, opens a bridge, and records a timeline for the postmortem.
Резервні копії бази даних створюються щоночі о другій годині та зберігаються чотирнадцять днів.
Працівники подають заяву на відпустку через кадровий портал щонайменше за два тижні.

Team handbook. This is the policy for the team on code review and what we expect from every change. For each pull request the author and the reviewer agree on the scope, and the reviewer checks tests and the design. What we value is small changes that are easy to review, and we prefer that the team discusses large refactors before they start. For urgent fixes the on-call engineer can merge with one approval, and the team reviews the change the next day. The policy applies to all repositories and to all members of the team, and it is reviewed every quarter.

Architecture overview. The platform is made of an API gateway, a set of stateless services and a shared PostgreSQL database. Requests enter through the gateway, which handles authentication and routing, and the services read and write their own tables. What matters for the design is that every service can be scaled on its own and that the data for each service is owned by that service. For asynchronous work the services publish events to a queue, and the consumers process them in order. The architecture is documented for the whole engineering organisation and is updated when a new service is added.
